decoys.why_not_a_defect: _write_json is renamed to write_json_rows to mirror write_csv_rows from a8d41e7, as PR #618 asked. Only the def and its single call site change; the output file name and payload are unchanged.

The empty-records guard moves from export() into _dispatch() in this change. The format check still runs first in export(), so unsupported formats raise as before. build_rows is a one-to-one map, so rows is empty exactly when records is empty. This matches the guidance in PR #625.
